sections.A: Ulnar nerve kohni ke andar ki haddi ke peeche ek tunnel se guzarti hai. Kohni morne par nerve khinchti aur dabti hai.
sections.B: Chhoti ungli aur aadhi ring finger mein, aur haath ki pusht par usi taraf, jhunjhunahat aur sunn-pan. Baad mein haath ki kamzori.
sections.C: Kya kohni morne (phone, sona) se symptoms aate hain, aur kya haath ki pusht bhi sunn hai: yeh batata hai ke dabao kohni par hai ya kalai par.
sections.D: Sensation, ungliyan kholne aur pinch ki taaqat, aur haath ki muscles ka sukhna dekhein.
sections.E: Elbow flexion test (kohni poori mod kar 60 second), pressure ke saath, Tinel aur Froment tests.
sections.F: Kalai par ulnar nerve (Guyon canal), C8 radiculopathy aur thoracic outlet isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Barhta sukhna ya kamzori, ya sensation ke baghair sukhna aur muscle phurkna: foran refer.
sections.H: Gardan, TOS aur central wajahein rule out karein. Ulnar symptoms, positive elbow flexion test aur kamzori na barh rahi ho to cubital tunnel.
sections.I: Asal ilaaj samjhana aur aadat badalna hai: kohni der tak na morein, kohni par tek na lagayein, phone ke liye headset.
sections.M: Symptoms kitni baar, elbow flexion test mein symptoms tak waqt, pinch ki taaqat aur sukhna.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Phone par baat karte waqt kohni der tak muri rehti hai, is liye symptoms barhte hain.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
